toolArguments.prompt:
Create exactly ONE complete native B06 building sprite, not a sheet. Architecture identity reference: B06-appearance.png ONLY; ignore the crop camera, roads, trees and neighboring buildings. 低层非对称住宅组合：左侧较高坡屋顶、中央窄连接体、右侧低平顶翼部，实体墙与独立小窗。不是灰坡顶独栋换色。
Geometry: fixed orthographic source-road camera elevation 62.5 deg / azimuth 45 deg. Frontage screen -28.486362689 deg, depth +55.405984491 deg, walls screen-vertical. Not generic 30-degree isometric. Preserve chirality, no mirror/rotation/shear. Candidate envelope {'frontage': 11, 'depth': 7, 'height': 7.5}, production candidates only. Preserve asymmetric high left residential wing and lower right flat-roof wing with narrow connector, domestic small openings; no B01 shop fascia. Neutral-daylight thick-painted Japanese/anime contemporary urban style from original user reference, restrained clear edges; accepted buildings only qualitative light/finish reference. Soft upper-left daylight, restrained neutral shadows. Whole building and all feet inside frame with safe margin. True transparent RGBA background. No broad ground shadow, roads, sidewalk, ground patch, trees, rooftop trees, people, vehicles, text, logos, labels or guide marks. No yellow wash, global blue tint or glowing windows. Native requested 1536x1536; actual dimensions/alpha must be measured. Runtime derivative max edge 280. Never enlarge crop as native art. Source occlusions must not become attached trees or neighboring buildings. Exactly one output.

Reference roles in order: geometry proxy ONLY camera/footprint, appearance crop ONLY identity, user original ONLY paint style, B01 ONLY soft daylight finish. Geometry proxy has flat simplified left roof: add its pitched roof from appearance; do not copy proxy colors/labels. Only building and tiny essential steps, all ground transparent.

sourceSelection.boxConvention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; full building envelope plus context, not alpha segmentation
sourceSelection.identity: 低层非对称住宅组合：左侧较高坡屋顶、中央窄连接体、右侧低平顶翼部，实体墙与独立小窗。不是灰坡顶独栋换色。
sourceSelection.limitations: 源仅81×49像素，树遮挡部分入口和地脚；连接体是否同一产权不可判断，选择的是画面中的连体体量，不宣称真实建筑类型。
sourceSelection.dimensionStatus: PM shape candidates, not source measurements or user hard limits
sourceSelection.selectionReason: 低层非对称住宅组合：左侧较高坡屋顶、中央窄连接体、右侧低平顶翼部，实体墙与独立小窗。不是灰坡顶独栋换色。

visualInspection: 已实际打开原生与运行PNG；主体完整，留有透明边，墙竖边目视屏幕竖直。
少量原生白色轮廓碎边/游离alpha碎点，未修原生像素；运行缩小后窗细节软化。
底边目视约-28°/+55°，仅估读，不是精确相机或地基标定。
坡顶左翼、窄连接和低平顶右翼可辨；正面大窗多于源裁片，仍偏B01浅墙大窗配方，需父会话审阅。
